ingredients.item: sirloin or tenderloin, cut into 3 cm cubes
ingredients.preparation: refrigerated until the toss — food safety is the one place this record is strict

ingredients.item: Steamed rice , gireumjang for extra dipping, kimchi , lettuce ssam

instructions.heading: Step 1
instructions.action: Toss the first batch: meat into the bowl, hands or tongs, thirty seconds of turning until every cube wears the mix. Onto the hot grate with a finger's width between cubes — crowded cubes steam gray.
instructions.visualOrTactileCue: the cubes should hit with an aggressive sizzle and the sesame-garlic smell should rise immediately. No sizzle, no sear — pull the batch back and let the grate recover.

instructions.heading: Step 2
instructions.action: Grill 90 seconds undisturbed, turn each cube to a new face, another 90 seconds, then roll to the last faces for 30–60 seconds. Total cook: about 4 minutes for medium at 3 cm. Pull when the faces are browned and the cube feels softly springy at a finger press.
instructions.visualOrTactileCue: cut one open at the grill station: a thin browned crust and a rosy interior. Gray to the center means the grate was too cool or the cubes too big — 3 cm is the ceiling.

instructions.heading: Step 3
instructions.action: Sesame seeds over, warm platter, straight to the table. Toss the next batch while the table eats this one — the rhythm of the record is toss, grill, eat, repeat, and the meat is at its best in the first minute off the fire.
instructions.visualOrTactileCue: eating test: crust, juice, sesame. The center should taste of beef and black pepper more than soy — if it reads salty, the soy ran a teaspoon heavy; the toss is measured in grams for a reason.

storageNotes: This is a cook-and-eat record; the toss doesn't hold. Leftover cooked cubes keep 2 days and make the best fried rice in this whole category — the sesame-garlic crust re-toasts beautifully in a hot pan.

Variations: a teaspoon of gochugaru in the toss for slow heat; butter and a splash of soy in the last minute for a glaze finish; the same toss on a whole sliced skirt steak, grilled as sheets, is the fastest cousin of #M01 without the slurry.
